meta.purpose: Priority employers and their known ATS/careers domains. Jobs from these sources get a legitimacy boost and are treated as higher-quality than generic job-board reposts.
meta.usage: Prefer applying through the employer's own careers page/ATS over a third-party repost of the same job.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: Tampa General Hospital
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Current employer. Internal transfer path — apply internally first for lab/research/lead roles.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: Moffitt Cancer Center
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Top target: cytology, pathology, clinical research, specimen processing. Strong fit for cytology background.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: BayCare Health System
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Large Tampa Bay footprint; lab, phlebotomy, specimen processing.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: AdventHealth
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Central FL + Tampa; lab and phlebotomy leadership.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: HCA Healthcare (West Florida)
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Many Tampa/Brooksville/Spring Hill hospitals; lab and specimen roles.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: Johns Hopkins All Children's
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: St. Petersburg; research and lab roles.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: Lakeland Regional Health
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Commutable via Polk County; lab operations.

tier_1_local_health_systems.name: Mayo Clinic Florida
tier_1_local_health_systems.notes: Jacksonville-based; prioritize remote/hybrid clinical research and lab-data roles.

tier_1_diagnostics_labs.name: Quest Diagnostics
tier_1_diagnostics_labs.notes: Specimen processing, accessioning, phlebotomy lead, lab supervisor.

tier_1_diagnostics_labs.name: Labcorp
tier_1_diagnostics_labs.notes: Specimen processing supervisor, phlebotomy, CRO arm (Labcorp Drug Development) for research roles.

tier_1_diagnostics_labs.name: OneBlood
tier_1_diagnostics_labs.notes: Donor center supervisor, mobile phlebotomy lead — strong fit for lead phlebotomy.

tier_1_diagnostics_labs.name: Florida Cancer Specialists
tier_1_diagnostics_labs.notes: Oncology; lab, research, and specimen roles align with cytology background.

tier_1_universities.name: USF Health / University of South Florida
tier_1_universities.notes: Research lab coordinator, clinical research coordinator, adjunct/instructor. WES-friendly.

tier_1_universities.name: HigherEdJobs (aggregator)
tier_1_universities.notes: Adjunct, instructor, research coordinator listings across FL universities.

tier_1_cros_pharma.name: ICON plc
tier_1_cros_pharma.notes: CRO; remote clinical trial assistant, clinical data roles.

tier_1_cros_pharma.name: IQVIA
tier_1_cros_pharma.notes: CRO/data; remote clinical data coordinator, CTA.

tier_1_cros_pharma.name: PPD / Thermo Fisher
tier_1_cros_pharma.notes: CRO + diagnostics; CTA, lab, data roles. Thermo has FL sites.

tier_1_cros_pharma.name: Parexel
tier_1_cros_pharma.notes: CRO; remote CTA and clinical support.

tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.name: Exact Sciences
tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.notes: Specimen processing, lab, clinical research support.

tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.name: Guardant Health
tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.notes: Oncology diagnostics; lab and clinical roles.

tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.name: Tempus
tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.notes: Oncology data + labs; clinical data and lab roles.

tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.name: NeoGenomics
tier_1_molecular_diagnostics.notes: Cancer/oncology lab (FL-based, Fort Myers) — excellent cytology/pathology fit; some remote data roles.
